subject: Discovery Recap: Inference cost pressure & next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.j@finbridge.com>, Priya Rao <priya@finbridge.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Sep 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Discovery Recap: Inference cost pressure & next steps

Hi Alex / Priya

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our end so we're all aligned and to make next steps explicit. Let me know if I missed anything.

Pain points you shared:
- High per-token cost on existing hosted endpoints; production unit economics are eroding margins as usage scales.
- Latency spikes at peak times (p95 around ~400-600ms) impacting user UX.
- Poor batching/cache behavior across multi-tenant architecture; many short requests preventing effective batching.
- Tight security/compliance requirements (VPC + audit logs) for customer data.

Current stack (what I heard):
- Front-end calls -> API layer -> OpenAI (primary) for generation + in-house Llama2 (small) for classification.
- Deployed on GCP; some GPU infra for experimentation but most traffic hits hosted API.

Success criteria for a pilot / POC:
1) Reduce inference cost per 1k tokens by ~40-60% (target range you mentioned).
2) Maintain p95 latency <= 300ms for typical requests; < 500ms for longer generation.
3) Demonstrate batching/prefix-caching improves unit economics for your workload.
4) Security: VPC/private deployment option or equivalent network controls and audit logging.
5) Quality: acceptable if quantization yields <~2% drop in key metric (NPS / intent accuracy) - you're open to aggressive quantization if we can validate.

Recommended next steps (what I propose):
- Technical deep-dive with Monica (solutions engineer) to walk model formats, expected batching/caching patterns, and sample inference benchmark. 60-90 mins.
- I'll share a concise pricing sheet + mutual action plan (MAP) outlining a 30-day POC scope and success gates.
- You share a representative prompt set + request volume profile (tokens per request, peak RPS, percent of short vs long requests).

Attachments: redwood-pricing-sheet.pdf (pricing + POC options), finbridge-map-mapping.xlsx (template MAP).

Proposed timing: Tech deep-dive next week (Wed 09/23 or Thu 09/24) - what works best for your team?

Thanks - excited to dig in.


Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com | (415) 555-0193

From: Alex Johnson <alex.j@finbridge.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Rao <priya@finbridge.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Sep 2026 15:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discovery Recap: Inference cost pressure & next steps

Marissa, thanks for the clear recap. This captures it well. A few clarifications and answers to your asks: 

- Volume profile: average 5k requests/day today, expected to ramp to ~50k/day within 3-4 months if we solve cost. Peak RPS currently ~18 RPS, very spiky (10s bursts up to ~120 RPS during batch jobs).
- Tokens: typical conversational turn ~300 tokens; some long-generations up to 2k tokens but ~70% of traffic is <500 tokens.
- Batching/cache: our current infra doesn't batch at the API layer; many clients call individually. We do some request coalescing at the backend but it's minimal. Prefix caching might help a lot for our chat summaries.
- Quantization: we are open to int8 / mixed quantization for the model if you can show minimal accuracy impact on our NLU intent detection (we track F1).
- Security: VPC or private deployment is a hard requirement.

POC timeline: target start in the next 2-3 weeks. Ideally a 4-week POC: week 1 onboarding + data sharing, week 2 run benchmarks, week 3 tune batch/cache configs, week 4 validate metrics & cost delta.

Let's lock the technical deep-dive for Wed 09/23 10:00-11:30 PT if that slot's available. Monica, any objections to that time?

Appreciate the attachments - will review and share our prompt set by EOD Friday.

Best,
Alex
